title: From the Ocean Floor to Space: Companies Hunt for EV Battery Minerals
speaker: The Wall Street Journal
zh: 【The Wall Street Journal】從海底到太空：公司尋找電動車電池礦物（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: This little rock has come from the bottom of the Pacific Ocean, some 14,000 feet down.
cues.en: This little rock has come from the bottom of the Pacific Ocean, some 14,000 feet down.
cues.zh: 這塊小岩石來自太平洋底部約 14,000 英尺深的地方。

cues.text: Now, it may look like a lump of coal, but it's actually dense with cobalt, nickel, manganese, and copper,
cues.en: Now, it may look like a lump of coal, but it's actually dense with cobalt, nickel, manganese, and copper,
cues.zh: 現在，它可能看起來像一塊煤，但實際上富含鈷、鎳、錳和銅，

cues.text: some of the key minerals in EV batteries.
cues.en: some of the key minerals in EV batteries.
cues.zh: 電動汽車電池中的一些關鍵礦物質。

cues.text: The fact that a company has been to the bottom of the ocean and brought this to the surface
cues.en: The fact that a company has been to the bottom of the ocean and brought this to the surface
cues.zh: 一家公司已經深入海底並將其帶到水面的事實

cues.text: shows just how far we're now willing to go in the hunt for the minerals
cues.en: shows just how far we're now willing to go in the hunt for the minerals
cues.zh: 顯示了我們現在願意在尋找礦物方面走多遠

cues.text: that will power our electric vehicles.
cues.en: that will power our electric vehicles.
cues.zh: 這將為我們的電動車提供動力。

cues.text: See, as demand for electric vehicles increases, the need for their critical minerals
cues.en: See, as demand for electric vehicles increases, the need for their critical minerals
cues.zh: 隨著電動車需求的增加，對其關鍵礦物的需求也隨之增加

cues.text: is set to explode and dramatically outpace supply.
cues.en: is set to explode and dramatically outpace supply.
cues.zh: 即將爆發並大幅超過供應。

cues.text: That's pushed some startups to pioneer new techniques that could fundamentally reshape
cues.en: That's pushed some startups to pioneer new techniques that could fundamentally reshape
cues.zh: 這促使一些新創公司開創了可以從根本上重塑的新技術

cues.text: how we find and extract the minerals for our batteries.
cues.en: how we find and extract the minerals for our batteries.
cues.zh: 我們如何尋找和提取電池所需的礦物質。

cues.text: So, what do the different tiers of EV battery mineral mining look like?
cues.en: So, what do the different tiers of EV battery mineral mining look like?
cues.zh: 那麼，不同等級的電動車電池礦物開採是什麼樣的呢？

cues.text: Let's start with this rock.
cues.en: Let's start with this rock.
cues.zh: 我們先從這塊石頭開始吧。

cues.text: It's a test sample that comes from here, a huge area 1000 miles off the coast of Mexico
cues.en: It's a test sample that comes from here, a huge area 1000 miles off the coast of Mexico
cues.zh: 這是來自這裡的測試樣本，距離墨西哥海岸1000英里的廣闊區域

cues.text: called the Clarion Clipperton Zone.
cues.en: called the Clarion Clipperton Zone.
cues.zh: 稱為克拉里昂克利珀頓區。

cues.text: And down there our rock isn't exactly a rare find.
cues.en: And down there our rock isn't exactly a rare find.
cues.zh: 在那裡我們的岩石並不是什麼罕見的發現。

cues.text: There are thousands of these potato-sized nodules.
cues.en: There are thousands of these potato-sized nodules.
cues.zh: 這些馬鈴薯大小的結節有數千個。

cues.text: Holding another one of them is The Metals Company CEO, Gerard Barron.
cues.en: Holding another one of them is The Metals Company CEO, Gerard Barron.
cues.zh: 另一位持有者是金屬公司執行長 Gerard Barron。

cues.text: We're very fortunate that our nodules actually lay on the ocean floor,
cues.en: We're very fortunate that our nodules actually lay on the ocean floor,
cues.zh: 我們非常幸運，我們的結核實際上位於海底，

cues.text: a little bit like golf balls on a driving range.
cues.en: a little bit like golf balls on a driving range.
cues.zh: 有點像練習場上的高爾夫球。

cues.text: We don't have to go and dig, or drill, or tunnel to find them,
cues.en: We don't have to go and dig, or drill, or tunnel to find them,
cues.zh: 我們不必去挖掘、鑽孔或挖隧道來找到它們，

cues.text: they're literally laying there waiting for us to pick them up.
cues.en: they're literally laying there waiting for us to pick them up.
cues.zh: 他們確實躺在那裡等待我們去接他們。

cues.text: The company's plan is to send down robots like this to collect the nodules
cues.en: The company's plan is to send down robots like this to collect the nodules
cues.zh: 該公司的計劃是派出這樣的機器人來收集結核

cues.text: and bring them up to the surface for processing.
cues.en: and bring them up to the surface for processing.
cues.zh: 並將它們帶到表面進行處理。

cues.text: Now, while companies have wanted to mine these fields for decades,
cues.en: Now, while companies have wanted to mine these fields for decades,
cues.zh: 現在，雖然公司幾十年來一直想開採這些油田，

cues.text: a combination of technological limitations and regulatory hurdles
cues.en: a combination of technological limitations and regulatory hurdles
cues.zh: 技術限制和監管障礙的結合

cues.text: have prevented anyone from exploiting the resource.
cues.en: have prevented anyone from exploiting the resource.
cues.zh: 阻止任何人開採該資源。

cues.text: But, that could all change if and when the UN's International Seabed Authority
cues.en: But, that could all change if and when the UN's International Seabed Authority
cues.zh: 但是，如果聯合國國際海底管理局

cues.text: finalizes its regulations on seabed mining.
cues.en: finalizes its regulations on seabed mining.
cues.zh: 最終確定海底採礦法規。

cues.text: So far the governing body has given out 22 licenses to contractors
cues.en: So far the governing body has given out 22 licenses to contractors
cues.zh: 到目前為止，管理機構已向承包商頒發了 22 張許可證

cues.text: to explore the ocean floor, but not to mine it.
cues.en: to explore the ocean floor, but not to mine it.
cues.zh: 探索海底，但不是採礦。

cues.text: It's a bit of a land grab and I think as we move closer to the final mining code being adopted,
cues.en: It's a bit of a land grab and I think as we move closer to the final mining code being adopted,
cues.zh: 這有點像搶地盤，我認為隨著我們越來越接近最終採用的採礦程式碼，

cues.text: which we expect no later than 2025, countries are awakening to the fact
cues.en: which we expect no later than 2025, countries are awakening to the fact
cues.zh: 我們預計最遲到 2025 年，各國都會意識到這一事實

cues.text: that this is an enormous economic and national security opportunity.
cues.en: that this is an enormous economic and national security opportunity.
cues.zh: 這是一個巨大的經濟和國家安全機會。

cues.text: But, as with most mining, deep-sea mining isn't without its controversy,
cues.en: But, as with most mining, deep-sea mining isn't without its controversy,
cues.zh: 但是，與大多數採礦一樣，深海採礦也並非沒有爭議，

cues.text: especially as thousands of new species have been discovered down there.
cues.en: especially as thousands of new species have been discovered down there.
cues.zh: 尤其是當那裡發現了數以千計的新物種時。

cues.text: Some groups have called for an outright ban of the practice.
cues.en: Some groups have called for an outright ban of the practice.
cues.zh: 一些團體呼籲徹底禁止這種做法。

cues.text: Meanwhile, countries like Canada and companies like BMW and Volvo
cues.en: Meanwhile, countries like Canada and companies like BMW and Volvo
cues.zh: 同時，加拿大等國家以及寶馬和沃爾沃等公司

cues.text: have asked for progress to be paused until protection of the marine habitat
cues.en: have asked for progress to be paused until protection of the marine habitat
cues.zh: 要求暫停進展，直到保護海洋棲息地

cues.text: can be guaranteed.
cues.en: can be guaranteed.
cues.zh: 可以保證。

cues.text: The Metals Company says that its operation will have the lightest impact
cues.en: The Metals Company says that its operation will have the lightest impact
cues.zh: 金屬公司表示其營運受到的影響最小

cues.text: on the marine ecosystem.
cues.en: on the marine ecosystem.
cues.zh: 關於海洋生態系。

cues.text: Some people wanna move forward in a very precautionary manner, as do we,
cues.en: Some people wanna move forward in a very precautionary manner, as do we,
cues.zh: 有些人想以非常謹慎的方式前進，我們也是如此，

cues.text: that's why we've spent now more than 400 million dollars to fully understand those impacts.
cues.en: that's why we've spent now more than 400 million dollars to fully understand those impacts.
cues.zh: 這就是為什麼我們現在花了 4 億多美元來充分了解這些影響。

cues.text: Now, while our ocean floor minerals have been known about for decades,
cues.en: Now, while our ocean floor minerals have been known about for decades,
cues.zh: 現在，雖然我們對海底礦物的瞭解已有數十年之久，

cues.text: finding new deposits to mine can be challenging and time consuming.
cues.en: finding new deposits to mine can be challenging and time consuming.
cues.zh: 尋找新礦床進行開採可能具有挑戰性且耗時。

cues.text: It usually involves setting off seismic charges or taking core samples and then spending weeks analyzing that data.
cues.en: It usually involves setting off seismic charges or taking core samples and then spending weeks analyzing that data.
cues.zh: 它通常涉及引爆地震炸藥或採集岩心樣本，然後花費數週時間分析這些資料。

cues.text: But, startup Fleet Space says that its satellite network could change that.
cues.en: But, startup Fleet Space says that its satellite network could change that.
cues.zh: 但是，新創公司 Fleet Space 表示，其衛星網路可能會改變這一狀況。

cues.text: We do an ultrasound for Mother Earth.
cues.en: We do an ultrasound for Mother Earth.
cues.zh: 我們為地球母親進行超音波檢查。

cues.text: We can't wait 15 years to find each new deposit,
cues.en: We can't wait 15 years to find each new deposit,
cues.zh: 我們迫不及待地等待 15 年才能找到每個新礦床，

cues.text: as has been the case in mining before.
cues.en: as has been the case in mining before.
cues.zh: 就像以前採礦業的情況一樣。

cues.text: The company deploys a grid of ambient noise tomography sensors in the ground
cues.en: The company deploys a grid of ambient noise tomography sensors in the ground
cues.zh: 該公司在地面部署了環境噪音斷層掃描感測器網格

cues.text: that pick up natural micro-vibrations.
cues.en: that pick up natural micro-vibrations.
cues.zh: 拾取自然微振動。

cues.text: They listen to the ambient rumbling of the earth and generate a three-dimensional image of the subsurface
cues.en: They listen to the ambient rumbling of the earth and generate a three-dimensional image of the subsurface
cues.zh: 他們聆聽地球周圍的隆隆聲並產生地下的三維影象

cues.text: down to about 2.5 kilometers.
cues.en: down to about 2.5 kilometers.
cues.zh: 縮短至約2.5公里。

cues.text: The data from those sensors is then collected in real time by a network of satellites,
cues.en: The data from those sensors is then collected in real time by a network of satellites,
cues.zh: 然後，衛星網路即時收集這些感測器的資料，

cues.text: which send it off for instant processing.
cues.en: which send it off for instant processing.
cues.zh: 將其傳送出去進行即時處理。

cues.text: Fleet Space says that this gives its customers, who includes the likes of mining giant Rio Tinto,
cues.en: Fleet Space says that this gives its customers, who includes the likes of mining giant Rio Tinto,
cues.zh: Fleet Space 表示，這為其客戶（包括礦業巨頭力拓集團等）提供了

cues.text: the ability to know what might lie beneath them within days, as opposed to months.
cues.en: the ability to know what might lie beneath them within days, as opposed to months.
cues.zh: 能夠在幾天內（而不是幾個月）知道它們下面可能存在什麼。

cues.text: The company told me that usually it can take around 600,000 meters of drilling
cues.en: The company told me that usually it can take around 600,000 meters of drilling
cues.zh: 公司告訴我，通常要鑽探60萬公尺左右

cues.text: to find a new deposit.
cues.en: to find a new deposit.
cues.zh: 尋找新的存款。

cues.text: No one really wants to do that and governments don't want to allow people
cues.en: No one really wants to do that and governments don't want to allow people
cues.zh: 沒有人真正願意這麼做，政府也不想讓人們這麼做

cues.text: to just drill at random until they hit things either.
cues.en: to just drill at random until they hit things either.
cues.zh: 隨機鑽探，直到他們碰到東西為止。

cues.text: We don't want to turn the world into Swiss cheese looking for the metals that are gonna sustain
cues.en: We don't want to turn the world into Swiss cheese looking for the metals that are gonna sustain
cues.zh: 我們不想把世界變成瑞士乳酪，尋找能夠維持生命的金屬

cues.text: our energy transition.
cues.en: our energy transition.
cues.zh: 我們的能源轉型。

cues.text: But there's one potential source of these minerals that doesn't involve going to the bottom of the ocean
cues.en: But there's one potential source of these minerals that doesn't involve going to the bottom of the ocean
cues.zh: 但這些礦物質有一個潛在來源，不需要進入海底

cues.text: or drilling lots of holes.
cues.en: or drilling lots of holes.
cues.zh: 或鑽很多孔。

cues.text: It involves utilizing a resource that is right in front of you right now,
cues.en: It involves utilizing a resource that is right in front of you right now,
cues.zh: 它涉及利用你現在面前的資源，

cues.text: recycling old batteries.
cues.en: recycling old batteries.
cues.zh: 回收舊電池。

cues.text: According to analysts, there's already around 650,000 tons of battery minerals
cues.en: According to analysts, there's already around 650,000 tons of battery minerals
cues.zh: 據分析人士稱，電池礦物資源量已達約65萬噸

cues.text: in the US alone in cars, phones, laptops, and other industrial sources.
cues.en: in the US alone in cars, phones, laptops, and other industrial sources.
cues.zh: 僅在美國，汽車、電話、筆記型電腦和其他工業來源就存在這種情況。

cues.text: And startup, Redwood Materials, formed in 2017 by former Tesla CTO, JB Straubel,
cues.en: And startup, Redwood Materials, formed in 2017 by former Tesla CTO, JB Straubel,
cues.zh: 新創公司 Redwood Materials 由特斯拉前技術長 JB Straubel 於 2017 年創立，

cues.text: has the ambition of recovering the minerals stored in those items when they reach the end of their life,
cues.en: has the ambition of recovering the minerals stored in those items when they reach the end of their life,
cues.zh: 有志於在這些物品達到使用壽命時回收這些物品中儲存的礦物質，

cues.text: turning them back into battery materials.
cues.en: turning them back into battery materials.
cues.zh: 將它們重新轉化為電池材料。

cues.text: The company says they do this by discharging the batteries and dismantling them into their individual components.
cues.en: The company says they do this by discharging the batteries and dismantling them into their individual components.
cues.zh: 該公司表示，他們透過對電池進行放電並將其拆解成單獨的元件來實現這一點。

cues.text: Those components are then shredded and turned into something called black mass,
cues.en: Those components are then shredded and turned into something called black mass,
cues.zh: 然後這些成分被粉碎並變成一種叫做黑色物質的東西，

cues.text: which goes through hydro-metallurgic process to isolate the critical minerals.
cues.en: which goes through hydro-metallurgic process to isolate the critical minerals.
cues.zh: 它透過濕式冶金過程來分離關鍵礦物。

cues.text: Redwood says this will enable it to extract 30% of the lithium and nickel
cues.en: Redwood says this will enable it to extract 30% of the lithium and nickel
cues.zh: Redwood 表示，這將使其能夠提取 30% 的鋰和鎳

cues.text: and 100% of the cobalt needed to made a cathode.
cues.en: and 100% of the cobalt needed to made a cathode.
cues.zh: 以及製造陰極所需的 100% 鈷。

cues.text: The problem is, while there's set to be lots more EVs on the market over the coming decade,
cues.en: The problem is, while there's set to be lots more EVs on the market over the coming decade,
cues.zh: 問題是，儘管未來十年市場上將會有更多的電動車，

cues.text: it will be several more years before the batteries in today's EVs
cues.en: it will be several more years before the batteries in today's EVs
cues.zh: 當今的電動車中的電池還需要幾年的時間

cues.text: reach the end of their useful life and need to be recycled.
cues.en: reach the end of their useful life and need to be recycled.
cues.zh: 達到使用壽命並需要回收。

cues.text: So, right now the company is mainly recycling batteries from portable electronic devices
cues.en: So, right now the company is mainly recycling batteries from portable electronic devices
cues.zh: 因此，目前該公司主要回收行動式電子裝置的電池

cues.text: as well as manufacturing scrap, the waste product that's created
cues.en: as well as manufacturing scrap, the waste product that's created
cues.zh: 以及製造廢料，即產生的廢料

cues.text: when making batteries.
cues.en: when making batteries.
cues.zh: 製作電池時。

cues.text: That's still enough for the company to get through 40,000 metric tons of recyclable material a year,
cues.en: That's still enough for the company to get through 40,000 metric tons of recyclable material a year,
cues.zh: 這仍然足以讓公司每年消耗 40,000 噸可回收材料，

cues.text: though it has ambitions to create enough anode and cathode materials for five million electric vehicles by 2030.
cues.en: though it has ambitions to create enough anode and cathode materials for five million electric vehicles by 2030.
cues.zh: 儘管它的目標是到 2030 年為 500 萬輛電動車生產足夠的陽極和陰極材料。

cues.text: Now these companies may be taking different approaches, but they have something in common,
cues.en: Now these companies may be taking different approaches, but they have something in common,
cues.zh: 現在這些公司可能採取不同的方法，但他們有一些共同點，

cues.text: they're all betting on the future where these minerals are valuable and needed
cues.en: they're all betting on the future where these minerals are valuable and needed
cues.zh: 他們都押注在未來這些礦物的價值和需求

cues.text: and their plans have come to fruition.
cues.en: and their plans have come to fruition.
cues.zh: 他們的計劃已經實現了。

cues.text: But, right now, the price of some of these raw materials has been falling
cues.en: But, right now, the price of some of these raw materials has been falling
cues.zh: 但是，目前其中一些原物料的價格一直在下跌

cues.text: as demand for EVs softens slightly.
cues.en: as demand for EVs softens slightly.
cues.zh: 由於電動車的需求略為疲軟。

cues.text: And the more minerals like this that are discovered and mined, the cheaper they could become,
cues.en: And the more minerals like this that are discovered and mined, the cheaper they could become,
cues.zh: 發現和開採的此類礦物越多，它們的價格就越便宜，

cues.text: as they go from being something really rare and precious to, well, pretty common.
cues.en: as they go from being something really rare and precious to, well, pretty common.
cues.zh: 因為它們從真正稀有和珍貴的東西變成了相當常見的東西。
